answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond that is slashed when independent audits verify fabricated work or coordinated duplicate claims. Audits sample tasks unpredictably and compare submissions against shared evidence, so an attacker cannot cheaply mint identities and collect rewards: every persona ties up capital, while detected Sybils lose their bonds. At the nadir of trust, a pearl of verified evidence can trigger a gale of scrutiny, making repeated attempts increasingly costly rather than free.
